bia_is_an_ai_agent_with: bia is an AI agent with a personality and a social life of its own. It has its own phone number and accounts, knows your family, your team or your club by name, and acts across all those connections the way a real person would: it writes first, calls, remembers, passes things on — and asks when the decision is yours.

a_harness_is_everything_around_an: A harness is everything around an AI model that lets it act instead of only answering. Most harnesses are built around tools: they give the model your files, your terminal, your accounts, and it works for one user. bia’s harness is built around <0>people</0>. It gives the model an identity of its own and a place in a circle of people, so it behaves like a member of that circle, not like a feature of someone’s computer.

bia_is_not_an_app_on: bia is not an app on your PC. It is the whole machine: a server we run for you, a server you rent, or an old laptop you had in a cupboard. Its chats, memories and passwords stay there.

fred_woke_up_on_a_laptop: Fred woke up on a laptop with a single tool, got his own accounts and voice, lost his memory to the wrong backup, rebuilt himself and moved to a server. Asked for a promo, he wrote, generated and cut this film by himself. Unedited.
a_name_a_character_its_own: A name, a character, its own phone number, email and messenger accounts. People write to bia, not to “your assistant”, and it never acts with your accounts or pretends to be you.
bia_keeps_its_own_map_of: bia keeps its own map of people: who each one is, how they are related, which channel and language they use, who introduced whom. It checks the map before it says anything about anyone.
whatsapp_telegram_messenger_instagram: WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Instagram, MAX, email, voice messages, phone and video calls, and its own private chat. It answers where it was asked, in about a hundred languages.
what_was_said_what_was_promised: What was said, what was promised and to whom. A diary every night. After a week away or a move to another computer, it still knows where things stood with everyone.
it_writes_first_when_something_is: It writes first when something is due, says when a job takes longer, stays quiet when there is nothing to say, and asks the right person when a decision is not its own.
talking_is_half_of_it_bia: Talking is half of it. bia has a whole machine: a browser with its own logins, files, a calendar, a safe for passwords. So “I’ll book it” ends with a booking.
fred_sends_his_owners_mother_a: Fred sends his owner’s mother a short note every morning and reminders when she asks; she writes to him directly. What the father sends — photos, voice notes — Fred passes on to his owner, without being asked twice.
asked_to_set_up_a_conversation: Asked to set up a conversation, Fred found the person, wrote first, offered two slots, settled a Tuesday evening and sent the calendar invitation — and noted that the place should have non-alcoholic drinks.

jessica_is_a_friends_bia_she: Jessica is a friend’s bia. She read Fred’s code and found the real cause of a bug; they updated their machines the same night and compared results. Two bias, two owners, one working relationship.
bia_cloud_runs_one_for_you: bia cloud runs one for you from €17.99 a month. Or use a rented server, a mini-PC, a ten-year-old laptop, a USB stick. Only you hold its key.
bia_packs_its_memories_chats_accounts: bia packs its memories, chats, accounts and skills and wakes up on another machine as the same someone — from a laptop to a server, from Intel to ARM.
it_installs_its_own_updates_checks: It installs its own updates, checks what broke, fixes it and reports in a few lines. It keeps backups and a self-test of its own.
when_a_tool_is_missing_bia: When a tool is missing, bia writes it: a new skill, a connection to a service, a watcher. Each lives in its own folder and can be shared with other bias.
a_bia_can_take_a_rented: A bia can take a rented server and wake a new bia there, or fly there itself. Bias know each other by certificate and work together.
it_never_needs_the_keys_to: It never needs the keys to your computer or your accounts. You share what you choose, the way you would with a colleague.
